description_text:

Customers should plan ahead and allow plenty of extra travel time.

For service updates, please check transport apps, information screens and listen to announcements.

header_text: Cumberland Line, Leppington & Inner West Line
description_text:
Allow extra travel time between Granville and Cabramatta due to urgent track repairs at Granville. Repair crews are on site and working to restore train services as soon as possible. Trains will be stopping at different platforms. Stops may change at short notice. 

Most trains will be diverted via Sefton to provide regular service. Customers travelling between Granville and Cabramatta via Merrylands are advised to consider catching nearby public transport services to continue their journey. We are trying to arrange replacement buses.  Please delay travel if possible or use other transport.  Well update you when we have more information. Customers should plan ahead and allow plenty of extra travel time.

For service updates, please check transport apps, information screens and listen to announcements.
